scripts.electron:compile: node scripts/electron-buildenv.mjs && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.setup.json
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build && npm run electron:compile && electron .
scripts.electron:build: npm run icons && npm run build && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --win --publish never --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run icons && npm run build && npm run electron:compile && npm run dmg:background && electron-builder --mac --publish never --config electron-builder.yml
